results.note: langfuse watch.W-01, watch.W-16: 6 scores (1 fail, 5 pass); 5 of 6 shown | reply says AB-10002 is shipped; the store said pending

results.rationale: Its only test was removed when the delivery claim and the idempotency ledger became one store (T-062, 8a40e85). A test against the merged store is owed: a far end that fails partway leaves nothing done or a compensating action recorded.
Offline, tool choices are scripted, so the suite tests what the harness does with a choice, never how often the choice is right. Needs a scored live eval with labelled tool choices.
